findings.title: Observations
items: execute_native_binary derives the 'external' projection SHA-256 from the same file it passes to the binary, so on the Python path the pin cannot disagree with the file. The correspondence check still compares program_sha256 with the reference lowering, which would surface a mismatch. The C CLI itself accepts a genuinely external pin.
ucm_native_core.c hashes the file and then reopens it to parse; a concurrent writer could change it between the two reads. Reading once into memory would remove that window.

The qualification shadow probe inserts src first and then checks where ucm came from, so it can only confirm that src/ucm imports. The real protection is the exported PYTHONPATH=src and PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 for children.

build_native_completion_r032_program.py --check now reports drift against current source; r032 is frozen and its files verify against the frozen registry, so this is the historical-builder pattern (also r026-r030).
Carried selections R28-07, R20-01 and the six r031 'tests.'-form selections still do not resolve against the current receipt.
